name: How long does it take to remove an old bathtub?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to remove an old bathtub?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required to remove an old bathtub can vary based on several factors, including the tub material (e.g., cast iron is heavier and more difficult), the surrounding tile and wall condition, and ease of access. A standard fiberglass or acrylic tub removal might take a few hours, while a heavy cast iron tub or one extensively tiled in place could take a full day. This estimate typically covers only the removal and disposal, not the installation of a new tub or shower.
acceptedAnswer.description: Removing a bathtub can take a few hours to a full day, depending on the tub's material and surrounding conditions. This estimate covers removal and disposal only.
